title: OCD Check test report (the "OCD Check report" issue form)
description: What the OCD Check owner build measured on one phone with one SIM, as pointers: each result names an entry of one OCD data release's closed list (volte, vowifi, sms_over_ims, video_calling or vonr, on or off, or apn: and a row key that release's apns-conf.xml has for the SIM's network) and the result class the phone measured. It never carries a value: no report can bring a new setting onto a phone. An observation, unverified: it never changes an OCD value, a generated file or a release, and it never makes a phone skip its own test. It holds no IMSI, ICCID, IMEI, phone number, SIP or tel URI, IP address, time of day, location or free text. tools/observed_reports.py checks it against this schema with stdlib code (the keyword subset of tools/validate_public_carrier_data.py), then runs the privacy scan, the consistency checks and the release checks a schema cannot express.

build.description: Only the owner build tests values; the read-only builds write no test report.

tested_on.description: The UTC date the test run started. A date only, never a time.

release.description: The OCD data release the entries point into. The tag must exist and carry this data digest; with a null tag (a bundled snapshot) the release is found by its digest.

data_source.description: pulled: the release the app fetched and checked against SHA256SUMS; bundled: the snapshot inside the app.

codename.description: Build.DEVICE, for example x1s: the device tree name LineageOS keys its carrier files by.

rom_family.description: The software family as the app detects it; the build strings themselves are never sent.

ims_stack.description: The IMS service the phone runs: PHH IMS (me.phh.ims), Samsung's (com.sec.imsservice), Google's AOSP ImsStack (com.android.imsstack), another one, or not readable.

spn.description: The service provider name the SIM shows, when it has one.

gid1_prefix.description: Only the GID1 prefix of the OCD profile the SIM matched, which OCD publishes; never the SIM's whole GID1.

ocd_profile.description: The most specific profile of the release the SIM matched; null when none matched.

results_left_out.description: APN row results the app left out so the prefilled issue fits a URL.

code.description: A fixed code from the app, never free text.

result.description: One entry and what the phone measured. reason, call_types, kept, method and restored are left out when they are empty, so the prefilled issue fits a URL.

entry.description: The entry of the release's closed list: a feature switch and value, or apn: and the row key (the APN in lower case, its types in lower case and sorted, its protocol), which must be a row the release has for the SIM's network.

ocd.description: The entry is OCD's value for this phone and SIM in the release (this model's device record, or the profile's capability: supported is on, unsupported is off). An APN row entry is always OCD's.

phone.description: The entry is the phone's own value before the test (for an APN row: the phone has the row).

how.description: observed: the phone's own value, seen without a change; tested: set for a while and reverted with proof.

result.description: works: an on entry signed in and passed the T2 call test (an outgoing and an incoming call on its bearer, audio confirmed; volte:on and vowifi:on only), an off entry of a voice feature took effect and a call went active with it, or mobile data validated with an APN row; signed_in: an on entry registered IMS with the feature's service on its bearer, no call test; service_off: an off entry took effect, the service went, no call measured; not_possible: an on entry cannot be on here (the modem, the IMS stack, the network's offer); failed: the entry was measured and did not work, or the test broke something (the reason says which); not_tested: no result, with the reason.

reason.description: Why: required for not_possible, failed and not_tested.

call_types.description: The calls measured for this entry and the call network type each showed.

kept.description: The entry passed its test and was applied locally (a non-persistent override, or the APN test row kept); left out when not.

method.description: How the phone's value was measured when it could not be seen as it was, for example wfc_override.

restored.description: After the revert the phone's own state came back within the window; false makes a failure unclean.

test.description: t2: the guided call test's passed outgoing and incoming calls; with_feature_off: a call of the owner's own that went active while the feature was off.
